question: Is dental care covered for adults?
expected_answer: No — excluded under all 8 plans
notes: Confirmed by reading the real chunks: 7 plans phrase it exactly as 'Dental care (Adult)'; Kaiser phrases the same exclusion as 'Dental Care (Adult & Child)', so an exact-string check for 'Dental care (Adult)' alone would miss Kaiser and wrongly suggest it's the one exception. Good real case for why answer-checking needs to be semantic, not a literal string match, at evaluation time.
